topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Well, now, this is just a fine mess, ain't it? A traveler comes through our village, winds in his sails, promising to make a great day even better by reaching his event timely. But no, the heavens decide to pour down rain, or maybe it was the wind, or who knows, the road just decides to be too long. What's a man to do when the world seems to conspire against him? His flight, delayed? What kind of trouble does that stir? Missing what was surely to be a grand occasion, all because the sky or the beasts of burden failed him. The saints must have their reasons, but they feel awfully distant right about now. Folk depend on these things, these flights, to keep their lives on track, and when they falter, it's the likes of us that feel the weight the most.
